meta.title: Have You Seen Our Kitten?
meta.textType: functional: a lost-pet notice and a short story

paragraphs: Mia has a new kitten. Her name is Snow. Snow is small and white, with two blue eyes. This morning, Snow is not in her box. "Oh no!" says Mia. "We lose Snow!" Mia looks in her bedroom, but Snow is not there. Mia runs to Lily's house. "Let's look for her," says Lily. They look in the garden and under the chairs. Snow is not there. "Let's make a notice," says Lily.

Lily writes a big notice with a picture. "Can you see our kitten?" "She is small and white." "Her name is Snow." "Please call or send a message." Mia and Lily put the notice outside the shop. They put one near the bus stop too. It is a sunny day, and many people walk in the street. Pip comes with them. Mia is quiet and sad.

Pip finds a big box and stops. "Woof, woof!" says Pip. Mia looks in the box. Snow is in the box! She hides there because she is frightened. "Snow!" says Mia. "Are you hungry?" Mia holds the kitten in her arms. "Good dog, Pip!" says Lily. Now Snow is not frightened. Mia is always happy with Pip near her.
text.summary: Mia loses her white kitten, Snow. Mia and Lily make a notice, and Pip finds Snow in a box.
